purpose: Compare 26 previously evaluated methods with two additional experimental families and their three mechanism ablations on five manually selected systems.
budget: Each problem's fixed budget, shared by every method; see freeze_manifest.json.
primary_measure: Expected ionic steps to first hit; unsuccessful timeouts are charged the full ionic-step budget.
reference: Lowest saved energy with guard plus wall <= 0.01 eV among this campaign and the archived same-hash future-systempilot records, using only the five selected systems.
pilot: BH and Growth, seeds 30-34, nominal full budgets; the pilot seeds are disjoint from formal seeds 100-199. All 60 saved best structures from six pilot systems passed baseline checks; only five systems are included here. The full audit includes the excluded system.
selection: Candidates were selected manually. Ag4/MFI is held out because its Ag-Si contact and framework interface remain insufficiently validated. Pd4/Al was excluded earlier after a disconnected saved candidate. Selection was not random; both exclusions and the full pilot audit are retained.

methods.transition_contextless: Ablation of transition_aos with contextual conditioning disabled.
methods.transition_nonovel: Ablation of transition_aos with transition-novelty reward disabled.
methods.response_nodirection: Ablation of response_search with the response-guided direction disabled.

limitations: The selected systems are convenience samples, not a random or representative sample. Selection used the pilot geometry checks.

Two new experimental method families plus three controls are not five independent inventions. The methods combine established ideas; neither literature novelty nor broad superiority has been established.
Development comparisons used only five seeds on six previously used development systems; random streams can diverge after initialization.

Mg4O4 showed a 1.915 Angstrom Mg-O contact and a short initial O-O contact in an earlier small pilot, despite the final selected-system pilot passing baseline checks. These are neither proven artifacts nor independently validated chemistry.
The graphene and Cu(111) hosts are ideal frozen structures with illustrative geometry; adsorption, substrate relaxation and alloying are not independently validated.
Initial sampling regions are not confinement constraints. Intermediate trace geometries were not saved, so saved-structure checks cannot certify every recorded hit.
NEP89 is a model, not DFT; guard, force and geometry tests do not establish physical correctness or a global minimum.
GOFEE and SurrBH have a 3600-second per-seed cap; ionic-step scores are not wall-clock rankings. Scores from different system sets are not directly comparable.
